description: Unit tests for nghttp2_data_provider derived from DataFrameSource, verifying data reading behavior under various conditions.

methods.name: ReadLessThanSourceProvides
methods.description: Tests reading less data than source provides, expecting successful read and correct flags.

methods.name: ReadMoreThanSourceProvides
methods.description: Tests reading more data than source provides, expecting EOF flags and full payload read.

methods.name: ReadFromBlockedSource
methods.description: Tests behavior when source is blocked, expecting deferred read result.

methods.name: ReadFromZeroLengthSource
methods.description: Tests behavior when source provides only fin with no data, expecting zero result and EOF flags.
